headline: Read your mill rate.
subhead: How to check your property taxes before making an offer in Southbury. Swipe.

slides.title: Find the mill rate
slides.text: Check the current Southbury town mill rate online. One mill equals one dollar of tax per one thousand dollars of assessed value.

slides.title: Check assessment ratios
slides.text: Connecticut assesses properties at seventy percent of fair market value. Multiply the market value by seventy percent to find the assessed value.

slides.title: Calculate annual taxes
slides.text: Multiply the assessed value by the mill rate, then divide by one thousand. This gives you the estimated yearly tax amount.

slides.title: Review past bills
slides.text: Ask to see past property tax bills for the specific address. Rates and assessments can change during town revaluation cycles.

recap: Calculate assessed value at seventy percent
